summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727 KB obfuscated bundle
details: @ornikar/jest-config-react@18.0.10 declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads Bun v1.3.13 from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/ (per-platform zip), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` (`execFileSync('bun', [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')],...)`). math_init.js is a ~727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle using string-array rotation (`MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())`), hex-numbered identifiers, and a large mixed number/string constant table. The obfuscated bundle is not referenced by the package's public entry point (jest-preset.js) and is only reachable via the preinstall→Bun execution path. A Jest configuration package has no functional need to fetch a second language runtime or execute an opaque bundled payload at install time. The pattern — alternate-runtime dropper carrying an obfuscated payload, executed automatically on `npm install` — grants the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
